tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sman mchod mtshan don ni/ 1$0000300khyab bdag kun bzang drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje chos dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtsug lag dpal dge khrag 'thung nag po dang*// shān+tiṃ gar+bha ba su dha ra la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba kun dngos pad 'byung yab yum dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes lo chen bai ro la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rgyal yab sras mchog gyur bde chen gling*// chos bdag skyes mchog brgyud par bcas rnams la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyad gnon lha brgyad sogs// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ las gshin gza' bdud dregs pa sde lnga sogs// chos gter skyong ba'i dam can rgya mtsho la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/
bdud rtsi'i lhag mas gnas gsum thig le bya zhing lcer myang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra a mṛta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes brjod/ gu ṇas zhabs tog tu spel ba dge// /
